ventures.name: Al-Busalah
ventures.description: Albousalh (البوصلة, 'The Compass') — Oman swarm-intelligence platform: a sovereign simulation and prediction platform wrapping the open-source MiroFish engine (v0.1.2) with a culturally localized Omani frontend (full RTL Arabic, national branding) for government, military, enterprise and academic users. Pipeline: upload unstructured documents (PDF/MD/TXT) as 'reality seeds' -> build knowledge graphs -> run multi-agent swarm simulations -> generate prediction reports. Differentiators (AV1-AV8): scenario comparison engine, stakeholder briefing generator, historical simulation library, confidence calibration dashboard (with deviation tracking of predictions vs. outcomes), collaborative annotation layer, Omani demographic overlay, alert & watch system, decision audit trail; three-tier bilingual AR/EN dashboards (decision maker / operations / system). Adding quantitative time-series forecasting (TimesFM-style) and live accuracy tracking. Production stack: Vue 3/Nuxt 3, TypeScript, Tailwind RTL, Pinia, ECharts, D3.js, PostgreSQL/Prisma. Interested in: MiroFish and its forks/derivatives, multi-agent/swarm and agent-based social simulation frameworks, LLM-agent society simulators, prediction/forecasting engines and time-series foundation models, document-to-knowledge-graph pipelines and GraphRAG, scenario-planning and decision-support tools, report generation from simulations, data visualization (D3/ECharts/graph viz), Arabic/RTL UI frameworks and component kits, geopolitical/demographic data tooling, confidence/uncertainty calibration and visualization, audit-trail and compliance logging.
